allistofearisgod: Gideon Allistofeari came up the line in the rain with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Gideon Allistofeari of the Hegemony and Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord watched a broken branch near the Brickworks all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Gideon Allistofeari kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Gideon Allistofeari fired at a movement across the wire at R-F16. The man went down: Marek Red, grazed.
Gideon Allistofeari drew the street leading to Dunmarrow. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.

The cook borrowed Gideon Allistofeari's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory. Gideon Allistofeari walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Water rose to the second step of the dugout. Gideon Allistofeari moved a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts to the highest shelf and sat beside it like a guard.
Gideon Allistofeari brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

Gideon Allistofeari was hit in the forearm at R-F16. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Teodor Deanc of the Concord (@deanc_67).
The wound on Gideon Allistofeari's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F16 in the middle of the night. Gideon Allistofeari met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Bastian "Lucky" Vpy of the Concord (@v01py).
Another member of the House of Allistofeari reached the line: Teodor Allistofeari. He asked where Gideon Allistofeari had slept, then chose a different corner.

The men at R-F16 heard Teodor Allistofeari call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Ulrich Deanc of the Concord (@deanc_67). Teodor Allistofeari was killed at R-F16 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Ulrich Deanc of the Concord (@deanc_67).

A letter came with Quentin Allistofeari: "I am Teodor Allistofeari's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin Allistofeari is number 128. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Quentin Allistofeari helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Quentin Allistofeari tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper.

Quentin Allistofeari lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-F16 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Felix Mvuisak was gravely wounded. A bullet went through Quentin Allistofeari's sleeve at R-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian Marceloferna of the Concord (@marcelofernando_32).
Quentin Allistofeari's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed.
Quentin Allistofeari healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
ashleyjsona.s: Zeno Ashleyjsona unpacked a key to a house that is no longer there at T-F23. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Zeno Ashleyjsona was hit in the hip at T-F23. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Nils "Lucky" Nguyen of the Concord (@khoi_nguyen6789). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Zeno Ashleyjsona folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Someone moved Zeno Ashleyjsona's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
The stretcher Zeno Ashleyjsona lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Zeno Ashleyjsona is back at T-F23, and someone else is lying in that dent now.
A new trench junction cost Zeno Ashleyjsona ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon.
Zeno Ashleyjsona wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
branden_l10: Bastian "Owl" Branden arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Bastian "Owl" Branden during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Bastian "Owl" Branden had Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag of the Concord in the sights at Hill 304 for a long second. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag was lighting a pipe. Bastian "Owl" Branden let the match burn all the way down. Bastian "Owl" Branden got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 803. The men who came later will ask about it. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Bastian "Owl" Branden shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
A round went through Bastian "Owl" Branden's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Isidor "Mole" Raptor of the Concord (@raptor2561).

Bastian "Owl" Branden was hit in the hip at R-C4. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Yann Spring of the Concord (@spring_7398). A single shot at R-C4. Bastian "Owl" Branden sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Yann Spring of the Concord (@spring_7398).
Silas Branden took the same post at R-C4 where Bastian "Owl" Branden stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Silas Branden won his boots at cards from a lance corporal in R-C4. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Silas Branden asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
burnett.jack2018: After 12 days of war, N-F13 had a place for everything. On Day 12, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Rafael "Lucky" Jack.
Someone asked Rafael "Lucky" Jack to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
A recruit asked Rafael "Lucky" Jack how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Rafael "Lucky" Jack counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
carrsonhartwig: The draft reached R-S11 on Day 6. Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
Gustav Ethanlam and Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
The colonel asked who held the line at the Hanging Bridge last night. Every finger pointed at Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw. Lance Corporal.
Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

The dugout has begun inventing endings to Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing. The clerk counted the names twice. Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw is number 409 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
The missing instalment reached Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw. The explanation was so poor that the dugout voted to keep the cook's ending.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw ate two helpings anyway.
cavocato: Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in S-R7 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato helped stack spare sandbags at S-R7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

The village shop had three kinds of soap. Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato stood at the counter far longer than the purchase required. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato answered to number 858. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
On dawn watch at S-R7, Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Teodor Jimmysparrow, now grazed.
Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato woke up at the usual time for night watch, even in the rear. It took several minutes to convince him to go back to sleep.
The sergeant at S-R7 called out a range and a spot. Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato was the only one who hit it. Matthias "Saint" Mulletoperat was gravely wounded.
A round went through Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Matthias "Doc" Gaita of the Hegemony (@gaita_4119).
gergely.v_: Marek "Button" Gergely took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded. The honour for Hill 304 was read aloud beside Marek "Button" Gergely. When it was over, someone quietly handed him the tea that had been kept warm.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Marek "Button" Gergely said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek "Button" Gergely. Marek "Button" Gergely read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The new duty roster listed Marek "Button" Gergely as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Marek "Button" Gergely taught Nils Noaskevitch to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek "Button" Gergely. Marek "Button" Gergely read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Marek "Button" Gergely kept the tin. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek "Button" Gergely. Marek "Button" Gergely read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Marek "Button" Gergely lent Quentin Lebronmygoat a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek "Button" Gergely. Marek "Button" Gergely read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Night raid. Marek "Button" Gergely crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Marek "Button" Gergely. On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Marek "Button" Gergely wrote the name in his diary with unusual care. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek "Button" Gergely. Marek "Button" Gergely read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

At Grey Mill, Marek "Button" Gergely and Florian Crdw exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek "Button" Gergely. Marek "Button" Gergely read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Marek "Button" Gergely answered to number 374. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Marek "Button" Gergely helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Marek "Button" Gergely fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Rafael "Whistle" Seankukhta was grazed trying to cross it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek "Button" Gergely. Marek "Button" Gergely read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Quentin Lebronmygoat and Marek "Button" Gergely divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek "Button" Gergely. Marek "Button" Gergely read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Marek "Button" Gergely tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-S10 is up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek "Button" Gergely. Marek "Button" Gergely read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Marek "Button" Gergely fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Quentin Zicharyafour was grazed. Marek "Button" Gergely raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-S10. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Cyril Jordancrowe of the Concord (@jordancrowe_). Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek "Button" Gergely. Marek "Button" Gergely read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
neurotoxic666: Severin "Saint" Neurotoxic was a choir singer in Oakmere until the posters went up. He came to N-F20 with a stub of a pencil, and within a day the whole squad knew that he laughs at exactly the wrong moments.
taishoredux: The sergeant gave Florian "Lucky" Taishoredux a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Florian "Lucky" Taishoredux wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Florian "Lucky" Taishoredux passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Florian "Lucky" Taishoredux read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Florian "Lucky" Taishoredux found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
Florian "Lucky" Taishoredux bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Florian "Lucky" Taishoredux said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Florian "Lucky" Taishoredux practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
travelling_gasmask: Day 9. The corporal put Matthias Gasmask beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. The new duty roster listed Matthias Gasmask as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Matthias Gasmask fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Leopold Nadana, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Matthias Gasmask helped stack spare sandbags at S-C5. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home reached Matthias Gasmask before dusk. Matthias Gasmask read it twice and slept a little easier.

Matthias Gasmask kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. A letter from home reached Matthias Gasmask before dusk. Matthias Gasmask read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Matthias Gasmask answered to number 734. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-C5. Matthias Gasmask has learned to walk bent double.

Matthias Gasmask brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived. A letter from home reached Matthias Gasmask before dusk. Matthias Gasmask read it twice and slept a little easier.

Matthias Gasmask read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. A letter from home reached Matthias Gasmask before dusk. Matthias Gasmask read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Matthias Gasmask tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-C5 is up. A letter from home reached Matthias Gasmask before dusk. Matthias Gasmask read it twice and slept a little easier.

Matthias Gasmask checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again. A letter from home reached Matthias Gasmask before dusk. Matthias Gasmask read it twice and slept a little easier.
